## Key Findings

### What Works Well
1. **Metadata generation is robust** - 98%+ title/description coverage across new-format repos
2. **Small repos perform best** - openai-realtime achieved perfect validation
3. **Cost is predictable** - ~$0.02 per module

### What Needs Improvement
1. **Documentation file generation** - 36.8% of errors are missing .md files
2. **Leaf diagram generation** - 18.8% of errors are missing diagrams for leaf modules
3. **Description length control** - 100% of warnings are description too long

---

## Recommendations

### Critical (Must Fix Before Production)
1. **Fix documentation file sync** - Ensure every module in tree has corresponding .md file
2. **Enforce diagram generation** - Add validation during generation to ensure all modules have diagrams

### High Priority
3. **Add post-processing** - Truncate descriptions to 2 sentences
4. **Improve error handling** - Handle partial failures gracefully

### Future Improvements
5. **Parallelize generation** - Could reduce time by 60-70%
6. **Add incremental updates** - Only regenerate changed modules
7. **Cache LLM responses** - Reduce costs for similar codebases

## How to Run Validation

```bash
# Single repo
cd /Users/shreyaspatel/atelier
source .venv/bin/activate
python codewiki/src/be/validation.py demo/repos/KubeElasti

# All repos
for repo in KubeElasti typer httpx rich fastapi openai-realtime; do
  echo "=== $repo ==="
  python codewiki/src/be/validation.py demo/repos/$repo
done

# Comprehensive analysis
python comprehensive_analysis.py
```
